preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.system_privilege WHERE name = 'patient:manage'

changeSet.comment: Privilege behind PRIV_PATIENT_MANAGE (order-entry patient persistence, patient merge)
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO clinlims.system_privilege (name, description, category) VALUES ('patient:manage', 'Persist patient demographics (order entry, merge)', 'patient');
INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_privilege (system_role_id, privilege_id) SELECT rp.system_role_id, (SELECT id FROM clinlims.system_privilege WHERE name = 'patient:manage') FROM clinlims.system_role_privilege rp JOIN clinlims.system_privilege p ON p.id = rp.privilege_id WHERE p.name = 'patient:edit';

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.system_privilege WHERE name = 'esig:use'

changeSet.comment: Grant esig:use to Results, after the privilege exists (idempotent)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_privilege (system_role_id, privilege_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM clinlims.system_role r, clinlims.system_privilege p WHERE trim(r.name) = 'Results' AND p.name = 'esig:use' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_privilege srp WHERE srp.system_role_id = r.id AND srp.privilege_id = p.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.system_role_privilege srp USING clinlims.system_role r, clinlims.system_privilege p WHERE srp.system_role_id = r.id AND srp.privilege_id = p.id AND trim(r.name) = 'Results' AND p.name = 'esig:use';
